title: Anthropic targets Nasdaq IPO listing window
summary: Reuters reports Anthropic now expects to begin IPO marketing in mid-October at the earliest, with the Nasdaq listing itself likely pushed past the November 2026 US midterm elections rather than landing in early October as previously reported.

title: Aurora PostgreSQL 16.8/17.4 reach end of standard support
summary: AWS's Aurora PostgreSQL release calendar lists November 2026 as the end-of-standard-support month for Aurora PostgreSQL minor versions 16.8 and 17.4.

title: AWS Lambda adds Node.js 26 and Python 3.15 runtimes
summary: AWS's Lambda runtimes table targets November 2026 for the addition of managed Node.js 26 and Python 3.15 runtimes, though AWS notes these dates are indicative and subject to change.

title: EU expected to designate AWS and Microsoft Azure as DMA gatekeepers
summary: The European Commission is expected to issue a formal decision around November 2026 designating AWS and Microsoft Azure as gatekeepers under the Digital Markets Act, the first time the DMA has been applied to cloud computing; a prior preliminary view was reached in June 2026 and compliance-specific remedies are unlikely before 2028.

sources.title: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services Face Tougher EU Scrutiny on Cloud

title: Google Play target API level extension deadline
summary: Developers granted an extension past Google Play's August 31, 2026 requirement that apps target Android 16 (API level 36) must bring their app into compliance by November 1, 2026 or lose the ability to publish updates to existing users.

sources.title: Target API level requirements for Google Play apps

title: Apple fiscal Q4 2026 earnings release
summary: Apple will report fiscal Q4 2026 results on Monday, November 2, 2026, with results around 1:30 p.m. PT and a 2:00 p.m. PT call; it will be new CEO John Ternus's first earnings call since succeeding Tim Cook on September 1.

title: GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines remove the macOS 14 hosted runner image

title: xAI retires grok-imagine-image-quality API model
summary: xAI's grok-imagine-image-quality model slug retires from the API on November 2, 2026 (60-day notice from Sept 2); requests will automatically be served by grok-imagine-image-2.0 at low quality, so existing code will not break.

title: CISA federal patch deadline for Plex2Shell, Siemens Software Center and SiteGuard flaws
summary: Federal civilian agencies must remediate a batch of flaws CISA added to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 20, 2026 by this date under BOD 26-04, including the Plex Media Server 'Plex2Shell' unauthenticated RCE chain, a Siemens Software Center DLL-sideloading flaw (CVE-2026-110936), and an EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition command-injection flaw (CVE-2026-106931).

sources.title: CISA: Hackers chain Plex flaws in 'Plex2Shell' attacks to breach servers

title: Qualcomm Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings release

summary: Apple's new iPad mini moves to an 8.5-inch OLED display, adds the A20 Pro chip and IP67 water/dust resistance, and starts at $699; announced October 26, pre-orders opened October 28, on sale November 6, 2026.

title: Amazon OpenSearch Service extended-support surcharge increases for legacy versions
summary: Starting November 7, 2026, AWS's Extended Support surcharge for legacy Elasticsearch (1.5-7.8) and OpenSearch (1.0-1.2, 2.3-2.9) versions on Amazon OpenSearch Service increases, as AWS extends the support window a further 12 months at a higher rate rather than ending it outright.

title: AWS Lambda deprecates the .NET 8 and .NET 9 runtimes
summary: AWS's own Lambda runtimes documentation lists November 10, 2026 as the deprecation date for both the dotnet8 and dotnet9 runtimes, matching the day Microsoft itself ends support for .NET 8 and .NET 9; after this date AWS may stop applying security patches to these runtimes.

summary: Microsoft ends support for the in-process worker model for .NET apps in Azure Functions; apps keep running but stop receiving security and feature updates unless migrated to the isolated worker model.

summary: Microsoft confirmed that .NET 8 (LTS) and .NET 9 (STS) both exit support on November 10, 2026, after which no further servicing updates or security fixes are provided; Microsoft is directing users to upgrade to .NET 10.

summary: Microsoft's free, online .NET Conf 2026 runs November 10-12, 2026, timed alongside the .NET 11 general-availability release.

summary: PowerShell 7.4 (LTS) and 7.5 reach end of support on the same date because their lifecycle is tied to the underlying .NET 8 runtime; Microsoft directs users to PowerShell 7.6 LTS.

title: OpenAI's direct model access for Cursor ends

summary: PostgreSQL 14, first released September 2021, exits community support on November 12, 2026 under PostgreSQL's five-year major-version policy; no further fixes, including security patches, will be issued after this date.
